replacement_fields.question: Complete using the British English past-tense form of smell (five letters): Yesterday she ___ smoke.
replacement_fields.gloss_en: perceived an odor; British past tense of smell
replacement_fields.gloss_zh: 闻到了；嗅到了（smell 的英式过去式）

replacement_fields.question: Use the past tense of hang meaning remain suspended: The curtains ___ loosely from the rod.
replacement_fields.gloss_en: remained suspended; past tense of hang
replacement_fields.gloss_zh: 悬挂着；垂挂着（hang 的过去式）

replacement_fields.question: Use the uncommon six-letter past-tense form of quit, ending in -tted: He ___ the post.
replacement_fields.gloss_en: ceased an activity; uncommon past form of quit
replacement_fields.gloss_zh: 停止了；结束了（quit 的较少见过去式）
